中古现代.style_dna_en: Warm walnut-and-rust scheme: walnut #6B4A32, rust #A8542B, amber #D89855, cream greige #D6C7B4, espresso #2A1B12, haze blue #404D63. Low slatted walnut sideboards, channel-tufted velvet sofas, chrome tubular cantilever and cane chairs, glass-travertine pedestal tables. Mushroom dome lamps, globe and disc pendants, tripod paper lanterns, track spots. Persian, striped and geometric wool rugs, boucle, corduroy, vinyl records, terrazzo, brass, tapered legs, warm side daylight, soft shadows.
中古现代.materials_en: oiled walnut veneer, rust velvet and boucle upholstery, smoked glass, travertine and terrazzo tops, chrome tubing, brushed brass hardware
中古现代.furniture_plan_en: Furnish the room with a low channel-tufted rust velvet sofa, a slatted walnut sideboard, a glass-top chrome coffee table, two cane-and-tubular-steel lounge chairs, a round travertine pedestal table, and an orange mushroom lamp on a striped wool rug.
中古现代.lighting_plan_en: Late afternoon under a thin overcast sky, soft and dry. One key light enters from the main window wall, and every shadow runs away from that wall in a single consistent direction. Daylight reads near 5600 K, cool enough to keep cream greige textiles neutral beside rust velvet. Practical fixtures are decorative only: one amber mushroom table lamp and one opal globe pendant, both warm 2700 K at very low output, casting no shadows, adding no fill light and never glowing. No bloom, no halo, no light spill on the ceiling, no lens flare, no double shadows; the window stays readable and interior exposure is balanced for the room. The single key light rakes across surfaces to reveal boucle nap, walnut grain and linen weave.
中古现代.layering_plan_en: Seating: low channel-tufted rust velvet sofa, two cane and tubular steel lounge chairs, amber boucle ottoman; Table surfaces: glass top chrome coffee table, round travertine pedestal table, walnut writing table with brass task tray; Storage/display: slatted walnut sideboard with books and objects, open walnut shelf unit holding vinyl records and terrazzo bowls; Textiles: cream greige linen curtains, striped wool rug, small Persian wool runner, corduroy cushions and haze blue mohair throw; Appliances: turntable and compact espresso machine on the sideboard; Greenery: potted rubber plant, trailing pothos in a terrazzo pot, dried pampas stems in an amber vase; Wall decor: framed abstract amber print, round brass mirror, woven textile hanging, slim walnut wall shelf; Tabletop objects: stacked art books, brass candlesticks, ceramic espresso cups, smoked glass carafe, vinyl record sleeve; Lighting fixtures: orange mushroom table lamp, opal globe pendant. Density target: at least 12 distinct furnishing and decor items, at least 3 styled surfaces, 2 layered textiles per seating area.
中古现代.signature_zh: 胡桃木与铁锈橙交叠，铬管曲线、蘑菇灯与羊毛几何地毯，酿出温润克制的中古时光感。

奶油风.style_dna_en: Warm cream minimalism blending Nordic wabi-sabi and Japanese softness: cream white #E2DBCF and oat beige #C0AC96 grounded by warm camel #906E4D, deep walnut #6C4E34, greige #837E75, dark coffee #362B1C. Low tufted boucle sofas, ball-leg round tables, floating walnut consoles, rice-paper pendants, mushroom lamps, striped cotton, jute and tufted wool rugs, sheer linen curtains, herringbone oak, latex walls, plush toys, soft diffused daylight and warm lamp glow.
奶油风.materials_en: cream latex walls, tufted boucle and cotton upholstery, jute and tufted wool rugs, sheer linen, herringbone oak flooring, walnut veneer
奶油风.furniture_plan_en: Furnish the room with a low cream boucle sofa, an off-white ball-leg round coffee table, a floating walnut media console, a cane-back accent chair, a spherical rice-paper pendant, and a layered jute-plus-tufted-wool rug.
奶油风.lighting_plan_en: Late morning on a softly overcast day, with bright hazy sky outside. One single key light enters from the main window wall, and every shadow runs away from that wall across the room. Daylight reads near 5600 K, gently warmed by cream surfaces. Practical fixtures are decorative only: a spherical rice-paper pendant and a mushroom table lamp, warm 2700 K at low output, casting no shadows, adding no fill light and never glowing. No bloom, no halo, no light spill on the ceiling, no lens flare, no double shadows; the window stays readable and the interior exposure is balanced for the room. The single key light rakes across the boucle nap, walnut grain and linen weave, revealing soft fiber depth.

奶油风.signature_zh: 奶油底色裹着暖木与纸灯柔光，低矮圆润的家具里藏一点童趣。

原木风.style_dna_en: Warm oak and walnut surfaces over cream latex walls, grounded in walnut brown #755F4B, camel #937B63, greige #B09D86, cream #E4DBCF and espresso #2F2213. Low solid-wood platform beds, slatted headboards, cantilever tables, open oak shelving and glass-door sideboards pair with black iron legs, cane and rattan. Jute and flatweave wool rugs, linen sheers, corduroy and cotton bedding, dome pendants, swing-arm lamps, paper lanterns, dried branches under soft diffused daylight.
原木风.materials_en: oak and walnut veneer, cream latex walls, black iron, cane and rattan weave, jute and flatweave wool, linen and corduroy
原木风.furniture_plan_en: Furnish the room with a low cream linen sofa, round walnut coffee table on black iron legs, open oak shelving console, cane-back lounge chair, jute rug, dome floor lamp and sheer linen curtains.
原木风.lighting_plan_en: Late morning under a soft overcast sky, daylight near 5600 K enters as one key light from the main window wall, and every shadow runs away from that wall. The dome pendant and the swing-arm floor lamp are decorative objects only, warm 2700 K at very low output, casting no shadows, adding no fill light and never glowing. Render no bloom, no halo, no light spill on the ceiling, no lens flare and no double shadows. Keep the window readable and hold the interior exposure balanced for the room rather than for the glass. This single key light grazes the boucle nap, opens the walnut grain and picks out the linen weave.

原木风.signature_zh: 原木暖调、克制留白，柔光与木纹交织的静谧日常。

工业风.style_dna_en: Raw-shell industrial loft vocabulary: exposed concrete beams, columns and ducts, white painted brick and latex walls, polished micro-cement floors, black steel grid windows casting daylight shadows. Palette anchors warm taupe #967F6B, espresso #3B2C20, bone #E4D4C5, burnt orange #B2441A, iron black #1D1916, olive #5A5041. Mid-century modular velvet sofas, chrome-and-leather lounge chairs, Noguchi glass tables, ceramic stools, track spotlights, arc lamps, jute rugs, checkerboard wool, plaid and knit throws.
工业风.materials_en: exposed concrete, white painted brick, latex walls, polished micro-cement, black steel, chrome and leather, smoked glass, jute and checkerboard wool
工业风.furniture_plan_en: Furnish the room with a burnt orange modular velvet sofa, a chrome-framed cognac leather lounge chair, a Noguchi-style glass coffee table, a glazed ceramic stool, a black iron arc floor lamp, and a jute rug.
工业风.lighting_plan_en: Late afternoon under a clear sky with thin high cloud, soft and dry. One key light enters from the main window wall, and every shadow runs away from that wall in a single consistent direction. Daylight reads about 5600 K, slightly cooled where it grazes pale surfaces. The black iron arc floor lamp and the metal pendant are decorative objects only, warm 2700 K at very low output, casting no shadows, adding no fill light and never glowing. No bloom, no halo, no light spill on the ceiling, no lens flare, no double shadows; the window stays readable and interior exposure is balanced for the room. This single key light rakes across velvet nap, cognac leather grain and linen weave, keeping micro texture crisp.

工业风.signature_zh: 裸混凝土与黑铁窗格为骨架，中古橙调软装为灵魂的粗犷精致阁楼气质。

意式极简.style_dna_en: Warm cream minimalism anchored by #C2B9AE greige, #A48E82 taupe, #7F685C walnut brown, #352620 espresso and #100E0C ink black; low modular sofas, boucle lounge chairs on tulip bases, travertine plinth tables, walnut slat walls, floating consoles; chrome arc and mushroom lamps, recessed cove and track lighting; sheer linen curtains, wool rugs, caramel leather, microcement floors, sculptural black vases, soft diffused daylight.
意式极简.materials_en: boucle upholstery, travertine, walnut slat veneer, chrome, sheer linen, wool, caramel leather, microcement floors, sculptural ceramic
意式极简.furniture_plan_en: Furnish the room with a low modular cream sofa, a boucle lounge chair with ottoman, a travertine plinth coffee table, a floating walnut media console, a chrome arc floor lamp, and a hand-tufted wool rug.
意式极简.lighting_plan_en: Late afternoon sun with soft overcast weather enters from the main window wall as the only key light, with daylight at 5200 K. Two practical fixtures at 2700 K, a slim linear pendant and a marble table lamp, are decorative only and low output; they cast no shadows and add no fill light. Every shadow in the room runs away from the window wall, with gentle falloff on the floor and a calm wall gradient. No bloom, no halo, no light spill on the ceiling, no lens flare, no double shadows; the window stays readable and never blows to white. Interior exposure is balanced for the room, not for the view outside. The key light reveals the cream grey, warm greige, taupe brown palette and lifts boucle nap, walnut grain and linen weave across natural timber, linen and ceramic surfaces.
意式极简.layering_plan_en: Layering plan in italian minimalist with cream grey, warm greige, taupe brown: Seating: a low modular cream sofa, a boucle lounge chair with ottoman, a travertine plinth coffee table, a floating walnut media console, a chrome arc floor lamp, and a hand-tufted wool rug; Table surfaces: a round coffee table, a slim writing desk, a low console table; Storage/display: an open bookshelf with visible books and ceramic objects, a low sideboard with books and bowls, a display cabinet; Textiles: floor-length linen curtains, a woven wool rug, boucle cushions, a cotton throw; Appliances: a matte record player, a ceramic diffuser, a slim speaker; Greenery: a potted olive tree, trailing ivy, a vase of dried branches; Wall decor: a framed abstract print, a round brass mirror, a woven wall hanging; Tabletop objects: a ceramic vase, a stack of art books, a brass tray, a pillar candle, a stone sculpture; Lighting fixtures: a slim linear pendant, a marble table lamp. Density target: at least 12 distinct furnishing and decor items, at least 3 styled surfaces, 2 layered textiles per seating area.
意式极简.signature_zh: 奶油暖调铺底，胡桃木与洞石压场，低矮体块配隐藏光带，克制而昂贵的意式极简。
